_comment: CI perf gate (scripts/perf-gate.py). Ceilings are ~5-10x the reference numbers in bench-*.json so shared CI runners don't flake. Verifier instruction counts are kernel-dependent (they count paths explored, not just instructions in the ELF): on GitHub's 7.0.0-azure runner with BPF-LSM active the LSM connect/sendmsg programs report ~13.7k, while the compiled object is ~1.5k static instructions (v0.3.1: ~1.0k). The previous 5500 ceiling came from a kernel where LSM was not attached, so the gate skipped it; 15000 still catches a real code-size regression. kavach_xdp grew 4528 -> 7064 with the AF_XDP redirect step.
